title: Rewind Review Respond
description: The Exhibitions Department published Rewind Review Respond starting in the fall of 2020 as a way to provide an online forum for discussion during remote classes due to the COVID-19 pandemic. The publication continued until CCA's closure.
thumbnailAltText: The words 'Rewind Review Respond' stacked vertically and mirrored in a few different fonts on a light pink background of the same words written in cursive script.
